title: Removal From Service Special Powers Amendment Act 2003

sections.shortTitle: Removal From Service Special Powers Amendment Act 2003
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT II OF 2003
ACT II OF 2003
REMOVAL FROM
SERVICE (SPECIAL POWERS)
(AMENDMENT) ACT,
2003
An Act further to
amend the Removal from Service
(Special Powers)
Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of
Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I, 16th July, 2003]
F.No.9(1)/2003-Legis., dated
16-7-2003.---The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the
assent of the President on 11th July, 2003 is hereby published for general
information:--
It is hereby enacted allowed:---
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Removal from Service
(Special Powers) (Amendment) Act, 2003.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Removal From Service Special Powers Amendment Act 2003
sections.description:
Amendment of section 2, Ordinance XVII of 2000

ACT II OF 2003
ACT II OF 2003
REMOVAL FROM
SERVICE (SPECIAL POWERS)
(AMENDMENT) ACT,
2003
An Act further to
amend the Removal from Service
(Special Powers)
Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of
Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I, 16th July, 2003]
F.No.9(1)/2003-Legis., dated
16-7-2003.---The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the
assent of the President on 11th July, 2003 is hereby published for general
information:--
It is hereby enacted allowed:---
2. Amendment of section 2,
Ordinance XVII of 2000.---In the Removal from Service (Special Powers)
Ordinance, 2000 (XVII of 2000), hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance,
in section 2,---
(a) clause (a)
shall be omitted; and
(b) In clause
(aa), for the words "Chief Executive", occurring twice, the words
"Prime Minister". shall be substituted.
